info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Policies Retrieval API
info.description: The Corporate Policies Retrieval API enables businesses to access and review their corporate policies, which govern operational procedures and compliance standards. Through this endpoint, users can retrieve specific policy details using a unique identifier. This API is particularly useful for compliance officers and management teams needing to ensure adherence to established guidelines. It streamlines the process of policy management and ensures that all stakeholders have access to the latest information.

get.description: Fetches the details of the corporate policy specified by the provided ID. This operation allows users to access the information associated with a particular corporate policy within the business direction framework.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the corporate policies for a specific business direction identified by RES-100045. Make sure to provide any necessary parameters to receive the relevant policies.

200.description: Successful retrieval of corporate policy details.

GetCorporatePoliciesByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving operations related to corporate policies.
